name: Warlock
fantasy: A pure evil spirit risen from the depths of an ancient jungle: a graceful figure of starry violet void, black thorned vines coiled up her limbs, a hood of dark leaves over fel green eyes, glowing orchids on her shoulders, her feet fading into roots and mist. Beautiful and wrong, in bright Warcraft colours. A run takes her down one of three roads: Corruption (stacking curses), Fear (crowd control) or Drain (life drain that overflows into shields).

directions.name: Corruption
directions.desc: Curses that stack and hurt more the longer they last.

directions.name: Fear
directions.desc: Scare enemies so they freeze or run, then hit them harder.

directions.name: Drain
directions.desc: Steal life to heal yourself; extra healing becomes a shield.

skills.name: Drain Life
skills.desc: Hold to drain life from an enemy with a green beam. It also hits up to 3 enemies near it, and everything it drains heals you.

skills.name: Blight Bolt
skills.desc: Throw a blight skull. It bursts and leaves a poison pool for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Soul Shackles
skills.desc: Chain every enemy within 7 metres in place for 2.5 seconds, hurting them.

skills.name: Fel Covenant
skills.desc: For 12 seconds you deal 40% more damage, and Drain Life hits more enemies and heals twice as much.

skills.name: Corruption
skills.desc: A cheap curse: 240% spell damage over 10 seconds.

skills.name: Malediction
skills.desc: A bolt for 90% spell damage, plus 50% for each of your curses on the enemy.

skills.name: Unending Rot
skills.desc: A curse that grows stronger the longer the enemy stays cursed, up to four times as strong.

skills.name: Festering Hex
skills.desc: A curse that bursts every 5 seconds for 120% spell damage and a short stun.

skills.name: Leeching Curse
skills.desc: A curse for 160% spell damage over 8 seconds. Half of it heals you.

skills.name: Reckoning
skills.desc: A curse for 6 seconds whose every tick hits as hard as all your other curses on the enemy put together.

skills.name: Terrify
skills.desc: Freeze an enemy in terror for 1.5 seconds. Scared enemies take 20% more from your spells.

skills.name: Dread Totem
skills.desc: Plant a totem for 8 seconds. It scares the first 3 enemies that come near it.

skills.name: Void Wisp
skills.desc: A wisp that bounces between up to 5 enemies, hurting and slowing each. Scared enemies take double.

skills.name: Eclipse Bloom
skills.desc: Blink up to 8 metres into a storm of void petals. Enemies caught are scared and keep getting hurt for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Leech Bolt
skills.desc: A quick bolt for 140% spell damage. 30% of it heals you.

skills.name: Thornlash
skills.desc: Lash thorned vines all around you for 180% spell damage. Each enemy hit heals you.

skills.name: Soul Feast
skills.desc: Channel for 3 seconds to drain every enemy within 7 metres. Healing past full life becomes a shield.

rites.name: Deep Drain

rites.name: Fel Intellect

rites.name: Siphon Efficiency
rites.text: Drain Life costs {cost:drain}% less mana.

rites.name: Forking Beam
rites.text: Drain Life forks to {drain_fork} more enemy.

rites.name: Withering
rites.text: +{dmg}% damage.

rites.name: Soul Glut

rites.name: Virulence
rites.text: Blight Bolt and its pools deal {dmg:blight}% more damage.

rites.name: Contagion
rites.text: Plague pools last {blight_dur} seconds longer.

rites.name: Quickened Rot
rites.text: Blight Bolt recharges {cd:blight}% faster.

rites.name: Fel Vigor
rites.text: +{life_pct}% maximum life.

rites.name: Spreading Rot
rites.text: Blight bursts and pools are {blight_size}% wider.

rites.name: Malice

rites.name: Twin Skulls
rites.text: Blight Bolt hurls two skulls.

rites.name: Fel Armor
rites.text: +{armor_pct}% defense.

rites.name: Arcane Reserves
rites.text: +{mana_pct}% maximum mana.

rites.name: Iron Chains
rites.text: Soul Shackles deal {dmg:shackles}% more damage and bind {shackle_dur} seconds longer.

rites.name: Warding Sigils
rites.text: +{res}% to all resistances.

rites.name: Binding Reach
rites.text: Soul Shackles reach {shackle_range} metres further.

rites.name: Dark Pact
rites.text: Fel Covenant recharges {cd:covenant}% faster and its damage bonus is {buff_pow}% higher.

rites.name: Eternal Covenant
rites.text: Fel Covenant lasts {buff_dur} seconds longer.

rites.name: Lingering Rot
rites.text: Your curses deal +{dot_flat} damage every tick.

rites.name: Slow Decay
rites.text: Your curses last {dot_dur}% longer.

rites.name: Thrifty Hexes
rites.text: Your curses cost {cost:w_corruption}% less mana.

rites.name: Vile Mending
rites.text: Each curse tick has a {dot_heal}% chance to heal you for 1% of your life.

rites.name: Echoing Corruption
rites.text: Recasting a curse makes all your curses on that enemy tick at once.

rites.name: Haunting
rites.text: Your fears and binds last {fear_dur} seconds longer.

rites.name: Nightmare Fuel
rites.text: Your spells deal {dmg_feared}% more to scared or chained enemies.

rites.name: Contagious Panic
rites.text: A scared enemy that runs into another scares it too.

rites.name: Dread Harvest
rites.text: Killing a scared enemy gives back 15 mana and takes 2 seconds off Terrify.

rites.name: Paralysing Terror
rites.text: When your fear ends, the enemy is stuck in place for 1 second.

rites.name: Thirsting Pact
rites.text: Drain Life deals {dmg:drain}% more damage and {ls}% of all your damage heals you.

rites.name: Blood Ward
rites.text: Healing past full life becomes a shield, up to {overheal_shield}% of your life. It melts away 5 seconds out of combat.

rites.name: Gorge
rites.text: Drain Life heals twice as much from foes below 30% life.

rites.name: Undying Hunger
rites.text: While your shield holds, Drain Life forks to {shield_fork} more foes and heals 25% more.

gems.name: Bloodglass
gems.text: Healing past full life becomes a shield, up to 15% of your life.

gems.name: Void Eye
gems.text: Your fears last 50% longer, and a feared foe is marked for your void wisps.
